name: nido
description: Let Codex create and use Pirol sandboxes — small virtual machines in the EU, CPU or with a GPU — through the nido command line on your computer. Runs as you, with your account.

interface.shortDescription: Run code in isolated sandboxes in the EU, CPU or GPU
interface.longDescription: nido runs code in isolated sandboxes: each one is a small virtual machine of its own, in the EU, run by Pirol. This plugin teaches Codex when and how to use them — create a sandbox, run tests, servers or training jobs in it, copy results back and clean up. Codex drives the nido command line on your computer, as you, with your account and budget. Needs nido installed and logged in once.
